text_block_list.text:
Opening the door to the trainer's office, 
—I found myself looking into another 
dimension entirely.

text_block_list.name: Eerie Voice
text_block_list.text:
So lonely... Where are you...? Don't leave 
me all alone...

text_block_list.name: Eerie Voice
text_block_list.text: ...A-Are you... on my side...?

Accompanied by a mysterious voice, 
something cold and hard touched my neck. 
Slowly, pressure began to apply—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ――, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ye were sprawled right out on the floor, 
so it gave me quite a fright, it did~! Are 
ye alright? Feelin' sick or somethin'?

What on earth was that just now? Wondering 
this, I looked around and noticed an 
unfamiliar doll placed on the desk.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? This doll belongs to Cafe-san! It's 
the one she showed me when I went to hang 
out in Tachyon-san and Cafe-san's room...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Though, I kinda feel like their hair was a 
bit shorter, but……

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
First off, let's let Cafe know. It 
might've dropped somewhere nearby and 
someone turned it in.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. It looks like it ran 
off on its own...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I thought it might be Cafe-san's doll~. 
I'm so glad we found the owner!
choice_data_list:
W-Why are you acting so completely 
normal...?

W-Why are you acting so completely 
normal...?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, this kind of thing happened all the 
time back in the countryside, so I guess 
you could say I'm used to it...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I feel like these kids aren't all 
that different from me! Look, we move 
around and our hair grows too!

text_block_list.name: Eerie Voice
text_block_list.text: So lonely... so lonely...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
My oh my, you can talk too, huh! Though, 
even after getting to see Cafe-san, why do 
you still feel lonely...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Ever since we met, she's been yearning 
for something... Before she causes any 
more trouble... I'll take her home...

Just as I felt inwardly relieved when 
Manhattan Cafe said she would take me 
back――

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Please wait, Cafe-san!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Is there really nothin' we can do about 
it...?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Her voice sounded so terribly sad... It'd 
be awful cruel to just say goodbye like 
this.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"However... wouldn't that be placing too 
much of a burden on you?"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: It's totally fine! Right, Trainer?!

Things are far from fine, but both of them 
are staring at me with hopeful eyes...
choice_data_list:
I'm not that tough, so I kind of want to 
pass on in peace.

Muster your guts and choose the path of 
coexistence...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Y-You can't force it, okay?! If we're to 
help it pass on peacefully, it has to be a 
way this child can accept...!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Once they find closure... once their 
lingering regrets fade, some children 
return to where they belong, but...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I'll watch over you so you 
won't feel lonely! I got energy to spare, 
after all!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
There, there, good girl. Aren't you just 
the cutest little thing~?

text_block_list.name: Eerie Voice
text_block_list.text: ...So warm...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Trainer-san, Cafe-san, please give 
this little one some pets, if you'd be so 
kind.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: So precious... so precious...

After spending several hours petting the 
doll between the three of them... that 
mysterious voice stopped completely.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. If we just talk to 'em, they might 
understand.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, I'll try talking them 
into it!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
What's the matter, little doll? Were ya 
that lonely?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Still, if you suddenly make stuff float or 
start talkin' to folks, you'll startle 'em 
and they'll all run away.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
If you behave yourself, everyone'll get 
along with you. Right?

text_block_list.name: Eerie Voice
text_block_list.text: Is that... true...?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! 'Cause you're just soooo cute. I'm 
gonna play with you a whole bunch!

Yukino Bijin met the doll's eyes and gave 
a gentle smile. I wondered if her 
persuasion would reach it, but—the 
mysterious voice ceased completely.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yukino-san is... truly a mysterious 
person, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Even when weird things happen... even 
with children others might find scary, 
she's always so gentle and kind..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
For being my roommate... without being 
afraid of me.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
What are you sayiiing?! I've always shared 
a room with Cafe-san, and I want to keep 
sharing with her forever!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
You don't have to keep your dolls and 
trinkets in Cafe-san and the others' room 
just out of concern for bothering me, you 
know? You can bring them over here!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Besides... when I was lonely and new to 
the academy, you made warm coffee for me. 
...You're the one who's truly kind, 
Cafe-san!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much... ...I'll brew 
some coffee for you again when we get 
back.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yes!

Witnessing the bond between Yukino Bijin 
and Manhattan Cafe warmed my heart as 
well.
